_note: Single-source (Mongolian, pre-Mongol-Empire steppe nomads). Mongol-Turkic sub-palette of the Steppe family; horse-nomad ovog clans of grassland and gobi-scrub, raised into hordes by the khan and the khural. clan = clanhold (the ordu is the mobile realm; the decimal host is its spine). CHAOTIC ALONE. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Mongol-Turkic register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the Steppe morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_steppe.json theonym_set), never real steppe gods (no Tengri/Erlik/Ulgen/Umai/Qormusta).

phonology.palette: Mongol-Turkic: vowel harmony; kh, gh, ch, sh, ng, q, ts; -ai/-ei diphthongs; agglutinative suffixes -tai/-dai/-chi/-khan; no initial clusters; theophoric on the morphed war- and sky-powers (Marakhai-, Tamendei-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC, no initial clusters; vowel harmony; final -n/-g/-r common.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic with the father's name + -in (of); the ovog (clan) name; an animal- or deed-byname; -tai/-dai (having) and -chi (doer) suffixes.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|animal](stem) + feature: Har-uul (black-mountain), Altan-gol (golden-river); the horde named for its khan: [khan]-yn Ordu.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (a horse-nomad confederation of ovog clans and their khans; the khural (assembly of chiefs) raises the khan; the horde (ordu) is the mobile realm)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Steppe clanhold, ascending. Built on khan: Khan (king) kingdom, Khagan (khan of khans) empire over the Yeke Ulus (the Great Nation). Noyan (noble) barony; Tarkhan (privileged border-lord) march; Zuun-Noyan (commander of a hundred) county; Mingghan-Noyan (commander of a thousand) duchy; Beki (great chief) principality. The khural (chiefs' assembly) raises the khan; the decimal war-host (arban/zuun/mingghan/tumen) is the realm's spine. (Rank titles are the real Mongol-Turkic register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal name + father's name (-in) and ovog (clan); a deed- or animal-byname, or the honor Baatar (hero) for the renowned.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the noyan-kin carry an ovog and an honor-title; commoners a single name + patronymic.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the Eternal Sky and the war-powers + an element: Munke- (eternal), -baatar (hero), Tomor- (iron): e.g. Munke-baatar, names sworn under Marakhai.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Steppe morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_steppe.json theonym_set) - never real Mongol/Turkic gods (no Tengri/Erlik/Ulgen/Umai/Qormusta). The Orkhan are Chaotic alone: they DEMONIZE the One (Eterun) as the Tyrant-Sky of the soft Lawful folk, and revile the Lawful powers as the gods of weak settled men. What they revere is the Wild Storm-Sky (Tamendei) - the untamed, ever-warring heaven that grants dominion to the strong - supreme over the Chaotic war-, plunder- and hunt-powers beneath it. The ovoo (sacred cairn) and the open sky are their altars; they raise no temples.
religion.the_one: Eterun (< Aeternus; the One, REVILED here as the Tyrant-Sky - the distant chain the Lawful would lay on free riders; cursed, never petitioned)

sample_deity_renames.Dementus: Tamendei (the Wild Storm-Sky; supreme of the venerated powers)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the One and the Lawful powers are the enemy-gods, named with curses: Aeternus -> Eterun the Tyrant-Sky (the chief enemy); Tulrius -> Tulai the Soft-Sun; Orlandus -> Orloch the Oath-Chain; Numeno -> Nomon the Scribe (mocked as the god of weaklings who write).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: no temples - the Ovoo (sacred stone-cairn) of [power] on a high place, hung with offerings: 'the Ovoo of Tamendei' atop the pass.
religion.saints_pattern: the great conqueror-khans and hero-baatars become storm-riders in the Wild Sky; honored at their ovoo and in the shaman's song.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tamendei: forked lightning across a black storm-sky
holy_symbol_motifs.Marakhai: a red horsetail war-standard (tug) beneath the storm

banks_patterns.ships: landlocked nomads name standards and warhorses, not ships: the tug-standards 'the Black Storm', 'the Red Wind'; great steeds 'Wind-Eater', 'Sky-Runner'
banks_patterns.military_units: the decimal host: the [khan] Tumen (10,000) / the [animal] Mingghan (1,000): 'the Wolf Tumen', 'the Storm Mingghan'
banks_patterns.taverns: camps, not taverns: the airag-tent / the [adjective] ger: 'the Khan's Airag-tent', 'the Red Ger'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned ordu-camps, balgas-ruins and kurgan barrow-tombs: 'the Kurgan of [khan]', 'the dead Balgas of [name]'
